text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket trains hard for the Osaka Hai. Despite her efforts though, her time is not improving.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to break through the wall she faces, we hold a scrimmage with Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide. Unfortunately, she still doesn't improve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket remarks positively that they ran a great race, but Biwa Hayahide counters, asking if she's not upset at the loss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though confused about the meaning of that question, Winning Ticket tries to stay eager to work hard.
